queries.name: migration_identity
queries.sql: select version, checksum from schema_migration order by version

queries.name: durable_data_version
queries.sql: select max(watermark, coalesce((select max(data_version) from committed_bundle), 0)) from data_version where id=1

queries.name: all_and_residential_totals_30d
queries.sql: select sum(m.upload),sum(m.download),count(distinct m.session_pk),count(distinct m.utc_minute),sum(case when (a.primary_category_id is not null or (a.primary_category_id is null and exists (select 1 from connection_chain rc join target_item rt on rt.set_id = 1 where rc.session_pk = m.session_pk and (rc.node = rt.name or (rt.name = '家宽' and instr(rc.node, '家宽') > 0))))) then m.upload else 0 end),sum(case when (a.primary_category_id is not null or (a.primary_category_id is null and exists (select 1 from connection_chain rc join target_item rt on rt.set_id = 1 where rc.session_pk = m.session_pk and (rc.node = rt.name or (rt.name = '家宽' and instr(rc.node, '家宽') > 0))))) then m.download else 0 end),count(distinct case when (a.primary_category_id is not null or (a.primary_category_id is null and exists (select 1 from connection_chain rc join target_item rt on rt.set_id = 1 where rc.session_pk = m.session_pk and (rc.node = rt.name or (rt.name = '家宽' and instr(rc.node, '家宽') > 0))))) then m.session_pk end),count(distinct case when (a.primary_category_id is not null or (a.primary_category_id is null and exists (select 1 from connection_chain rc join target_item rt on rt.set_id = 1 where rc.session_pk = m.session_pk and (rc.node = rt.name or (rt.name = '家宽' and instr(rc.node, '家宽') > 0))))) then m.utc_minute end) from connection_minute m join connection_session s on s.session_pk=m.session_pk left join connection_session_attr a on a.session_pk=s.session_pk where m.utc_minute>=? and m.utc_minute<?

queries.name: host-30d
queries.sql: select coalesce(nullif(s.host,''),'__unknown__') as identity,sum(m.upload),sum(m.download),count(distinct m.session_pk),count(distinct m.utc_minute)*60 from connection_minute m join connection_session s on s.session_pk=m.session_pk left join connection_session_attr a on a.session_pk=s.session_pk where m.utc_minute>=? and m.utc_minute<? and (a.primary_category_id is not null or (a.primary_category_id is null and exists (select 1 from connection_chain rc join target_item rt on rt.set_id = 1 where rc.session_pk = m.session_pk and (rc.node = rt.name or (rt.name = '家宽' and instr(rc.node, '家宽') > 0))))) group by identity order by sum(m.download) desc,identity asc limit ?

queries.name: host-1d
queries.sql: select coalesce(nullif(s.host,''),'__unknown__') as identity,sum(m.upload),sum(m.download),count(distinct m.session_pk),count(distinct m.utc_minute)*60 from connection_minute m join connection_session s on s.session_pk=m.session_pk left join connection_session_attr a on a.session_pk=s.session_pk where m.utc_minute>=? and m.utc_minute<? and (a.primary_category_id is not null or (a.primary_category_id is null and exists (select 1 from connection_chain rc join target_item rt on rt.set_id = 1 where rc.session_pk = m.session_pk and (rc.node = rt.name or (rt.name = '家宽' and instr(rc.node, '家宽') > 0))))) group by identity order by sum(m.download) desc,identity asc limit ?

queries.name: network-30d
queries.sql: select coalesce(nullif(d.value,''),'__unknown__') as identity,sum(m.upload),sum(m.download),count(distinct m.session_pk),count(distinct m.utc_minute)*60 from connection_minute m join connection_session s on s.session_pk=m.session_pk left join connection_session_attr a on a.session_pk=s.session_pk left join dimension_dict d on d.dimension_kind='network' and d.dimension_id=a.network_id where m.utc_minute>=? and m.utc_minute<? and (a.primary_category_id is not null or (a.primary_category_id is null and exists (select 1 from connection_chain rc join target_item rt on rt.set_id = 1 where rc.session_pk = m.session_pk and (rc.node = rt.name or (rt.name = '家宽' and instr(rc.node, '家宽') > 0))))) group by identity order by sum(m.download) desc,identity asc limit ?

limits: 通过生产 migration 建库，批量写入生产表；不代表真实门面提交或1Hz实时耗时。
生成专用连接使用64MiB页缓存；仅用于批量fixture生成，其内存样本不代表生产运行时占用。
固定5分钟会话寿命与3跳chain，复用C0维度基数；所有session已关闭，未伪造活跃保护/legacy证明。
receipt为显式合成的逐秒连续序列，payload_hash是固定fixture摘要；不用于重放安全证明。
进程路径未写入生产schema；host按5%长标签、process按进程名分布。尚未物化任何派生汇总。
